title: File:Refuge Liguori.jpg
claims: The file shows the Liguori lodge on the Sentier des Caps de Charlevoix, with the Saint Lawrence River and Île aux Coudres in the background.
The photograph was taken on 2011-03-20 and shows winter conditions; it documents the route environment, not the QMT135 race.
The author is Cephas, credited under CC BY-SA 3.0; the original file is 3,573 x 2,382 pixels.
The file page requires attribution and share-alike; the route page uses a 960 x 640 Commons thumbnail and credits the author and licence.
